newsitem.title: USA: U.S. foreign crude trade focuses on Latam tenders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. foreign crude trade focuses on Latam tenders.

text.p: An industry outing in Houston becalmed U.S. foreign crude trade on Friday, although several players were keeping an eye on a series of Latin American tenders, traders said.
In the Southern Cone, Chile's state oil refiner Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) purchased Ecuadoran Oriente and Angolan Nemba and Cabinda crudes in its latest tender, trade sources said.
ENAP bought the 380,000 barrel cargo of Oriente, which loads September 16-18, from a Latin trading house at around 20-25 cents a barrel over the fob formula for Chile.
The Chilean formula for Oriente crude is WTI minus $5.08 a barrel.
ENAP purchased the combination cargo of Nemba and Cabinda, totalling around 900,000 barrels, from a European major at a premium to Dated Brent.
The cargoes are due to arrive in Chile September 16-20.
Traders said that Oriente crude has been moving briskly in September, apparently because of the delay in renewed Iraqi humanitarian exports.
The Ecuadoran crude is currently assessed around $2.95-3.05 a barrel under October WTI on a delivered basis for the U.S. Gulf Coast.
A European company was heard to have sold an Oriente on Thursday at $3.00 under the benchmark, although the transaction could not be immediately confirmed.
Elsewhere in Latin America, traders were awaiting the results of Colombian state oil company Ecopetrol's mini-tenders for cargoes of Cano Limon and South Blend.
Offers were received on Thursday, with awards due late on Friday.
In other foreign trade activity, a U.S. company was showing North Sea Brent crude for September 20-30 delivery, asking October WTI minus 20 cents a barrel.
Several recent indications for Brent crude have piqued little interest among U.S. refiners, bolstering prices for competing crudes closer to home such as Colombian Cusiana.
Many traders were in Houston on Thursday anhd Friday attending an Amoco-sponsored crude oil reception and subsequent golf outing.
